topic: Petrol pump nozzle — how it stops by itself when the tank is full
title: Petrol Khud Kaise Ruk Jata Hai? 🤯 #shorts
title_en: How Does a Fuel Nozzle Stop by Itself? 🤯 #shorts
description:
Petrol pump ka nozzle tanki bharte hi khud kaise ruk jata hai?
Na koi sensor, na bijli — sirf hawa aur ek chhota sa suraakh! X-ray mein dekhiye poora kamaal.
Aur jaaniye jhaag ki wajah se tanki bharne se pehle hi "click" kyun ho jata hai.

How does a fuel nozzle know your tank is full? No electronics — just a tiny sensing hole, air suction and a diaphragm that trips the valve.

پیٹرول پمپ کا نوزل ٹینکی بھرتے ہی خود کیسے رک جاتا ہے؟

#howitworks #urdu #shorts #science #petrol #EZOXIFY
description_en:
How does a fuel nozzle stop by itself the moment your tank is full? There is no electronic sensor and no power in it — just air.
A tiny sensing hole near the tip, a thin tube, venturi suction and a rubber diaphragm that trips the valve: click! Foam covering the hole is why it sometimes clicks early.
